newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury says strong stg hurting manufacturers.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury says strong stg hurting manufacturers.

text.p: The government wants a stable and competitive pound and is aware that the recent rise in the exchange rate is making life tough for British manufacturers, Economic Secretary to the Treasury Helen Liddell said on Tuesday.
In written parliamentary answers, Liddell said the government does not have a policy of raising nominal or real exchange rates.
"The government wants a stable and competitive pound over the medium term, consistent with its objective of price stability," she told Labour MP Austin Mitchell.
Liddell said it was difficult to isolate the effect of the exchange rate from other factors that can effect output and employment.
"However, the government is aware that the recent appreciation of sterling is making life difficult for manufacturing industry," she added.
